name: Ortigosa del Monte (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ortigosa del Monte (quartered, a nettle on yellow and the aqueduct on red).
history: Ortigosa del Monte adopted its arms and flag officially on 10 October 2000, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 27 December 2000; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.
